questions.question: If 22 September 1982 is Wednesday, then what will be the day of the week on 7 December 1991?
questions.solution:
An ordinary year has 1 odd day and a leap year has 2 odd days. 

So, the day on the same date for an ordinary year will be 1 day ahead and the day on the same date for a leap year will be 2 days ahead for the next year.

If 22 September 1982 is Wednesday, then the day on these dates will be:

22 September 1983 → Thursday

22 September 1984 → Saturday

22 September 1985 → Sunday

22 September 1986 → Monday

22 September 1987 → Tuesday

22 September 1988 → Thursday

22 September 1989 → Friday

22 September 1990 → Saturday

22 September 1991 → Sunday

Number of days between 22 September to 7 December = (8 + 31 + 30 + 7) = 76

76 when divided by 7, we get 6 as remainder

Sunday + 6 = Saturday

So, it will be Saturday on 7 December 1991.

Hence, ‘**Saturday**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: The division of cytoplasm is known as:

• It is a critical step in cell division that follows karyokinesis.
 
• During cytokinesis, the cytoplasm divides into two daughter cells, each with a complete set of chromosomes.
 
• Cytokinesis involves the formation of a contractile ring around the cell, which constricts and separates the cytoplasm into two parts.
 
• The contractile ring is made up of actin and myosin filaments that help in the division of the cytoplasm.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• It is the division of the nucleus during cell division.
 
 
 
• **Cytoskeleton**:-
 
 
• It is a network of protein filaments that provide structural support and shape to the cell.
 
 
 
• **Cytosol**:-
 
 
• It is the fluid portion of the cytoplasm that surrounds the organelles.

questions.question: Gross Domestic Product less Depreciation is _________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Net Domestic Product**__.

__
 
• **Gross Domestic Product:**

 
 
• GDP is the total value of all goods and services produced within a country's borders in a given time period.
 
 
 
• Depreciation is the decrease in value of an asset over time due to wear and tear, obsolescence, or other factors.
 
• **NDP:-**
 
 
• It is a measure of the net output of the economy and is considered a more accurate indicator of economic growth than GDP.
 
• Gross Domestic Product less Depreciation is called Net Domestic Product (NDP). It represents the value of all goods and services produced within a country's borders minus the value of the capital goods (machinery, equipment, buildings, etc.) that were used up in the production process.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gross Domestic Investment:-**

 
 
• It refers to the total amount of money spent on capital goods (machinery, equipment, buildings, etc.) within a country's borders in a given time period.
 
 
 
• **Net National Product:-**
 
 
• It is the value of all goods and services produced by a country's residents, including those living abroad, minus depreciation.
 
 
 
• **Gross National Product:-**
 
 
• It is the value of all goods and services produced by a country's residents, including those living abroad, without subtracting depreciation.

Average = Sum of all values / Total no of values

Thus, the correct average = 524 / 18 = 29 (1)/(9)

**∴ The correct average of integers = 29 (1)/(9).**
